# wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account (Data Source)

Get information on an account of a local domain linked to an application, by `application_id`,
`domain_id`, and `account_name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wallix-bastion_application" "web_server" {
  application_name = "web_server"
}

data "wallix-bastion_application_localdomain" "web_local" {
  application_id = data.wallix-bastion_application.web_server.id
  domain_name     = "local"
}

# Get information about a specific account in this local domain
data "wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account" "web_admin" {
  application_id = data.wallix-bastion_application.web_server.id
  domain_id       = data.wallix-bastion_application_localdomain.web_local.id
  account_name    = "web_administrator"
}

# Use the account's id to look up its password credential
data "wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account_credential" "web_admin_cred" {
  application_id = data.wallix-bastion_application.web_server.id
  domain_id       = data.wallix-bastion_application_localdomain.web_local.id
  account_id      = data.wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account.web_admin.id
  type            = "password"
}

# Output account login and checkout policy
output "web_admin_summary" {
  value = {
    account_login   = data.wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account.web_admin.account_login
    checkout_policy = data.wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account.web_admin.checkout_policy
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `application_id` (String)
- `domain_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `account_login` (String)
- `auto_change_password` (Boolean)
- `checkout_policy` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `domain_password_change` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `password` (String, Sensitive)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Keys

`application_id`, `domain_id`, and `account_name` are all required to identify the account. The
data source returns an error if no account with that name exists on the given application/domain
pair.

### The `password` attribute

`password` is marked sensitive and reflects the value stored by the Bastion for this account, if
any. Actual credential values (e.g. the password used for connections) are managed separately via
`wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account_credential`.

### Using the Result

The data source's `id` (the account's ID) is the value to pass as `account_id` when reading or
managing `wallix-bastion_application_localdomain_account_credential` resources scoped to this
account.
